chunks: From him, from Muḥammad ibn al-Ḥusayn, from Wuhayb, from Abī Baṣīr, who said:
I asked Abā ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام about ink that gets on a garment and is not washed. He said: “There is no harm in it.”

key_terms.أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ: Imam Jaʿfar al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام, the Imam being asked for the ruling
key_terms.الثَّوْبَ: the garment or clothing affected by the ink
key_terms.الْمِدَادِ: ink that stains or reaches the garment
key_terms.فَلَا يُغْسَلُ: it is not washed after being affected
key_terms.لَا بَأْسَ بِهِ: there is no harm in it; it is not problematic

ai.seo_question: Does ink on clothing need to be washed according to Imam al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning ink that comes onto a garment. Imam al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام states that there is no problem with it, indicating that such a substance does not render the garment objectionable in this context.
